Synopsis:
The Flaming FIst Manip, Vidor, has conflict with Florrick prior to any of these dialogues. He is the sergeant of the FF troops, and believes Florrick is a terrible leader. Player can respond to his idea that he should attack Moonrise.

Cluster Contexts:
- HAV_SavingPrisoners_Manip.json: Vidor is a Flaming Fist manip—sergeant of the local troops—who already distrusts and openly opposes Captain Florrick, favoring aggressive action against perceived threats. This short exchange happens as the party is headed toward the Towers/Moonrise in the late-Act 2 epilogue period of the campaign, after the region has been afflicted by the Shadowfell/Absolute crisis. Vidor brings up attacking Moonrise as a course of action; the player can answer confrontationally or neutrally (the example shows a sarcastic retort). Off-screen tensions—Florrick’s contested leadership, the Flaming Fist chain of command, and the unsettled condition of the land tied to the broader curse—frame why Vidor pushes for violence and why the scene branches based on prior progress.

Dialogue Excerpts (up to 3 samples, ordered):
Sample 1:
- Manip Vidor: Heard you're meant to be heading toward the Towers. (node 3)
- Player: Doing your job, you mean. (node 14)
